text: More than 120 tonnes of coltan a month smuggled from Congo’s Rubaya mines into Rwanda since April 2024.
short: 120+ tonnes of coltan a month smuggled into Rwanda

source.name: Global Witness
source.quote: UN experts estimate that since April 2024 more than 120 tonnes of coltan per month were smuggled from Rubaya to Rwanda.

additionalSources.name: UN Security Council, Group of Experts on the Democratic Republic of the Congo, midterm report (S/2024/969)
additionalSources.quote: AFC/M23 thus controlled the trade and transport of around 120 tons of coltan monthly.
